summary: Thirty-nine messages, 22 from Vale and 17 from ALTR, and the ledger of carried items is unchanged: nothing closed, everything aged a further seven days. Two things did get fixed, and they should be said first. Stephski sent the pre-invoice OF-withdrawal reminder on Sep 14 — the exact item flagged as 'do not miss it twice running' last week — issued the Sep 1-14 invoice on schedule on Sep 15, and Vale paid it on Sep 16 in ONE DAY with a screenshot, the fastest turnaround of the year and her eleventh consecutive on-time payment. And Ollie Mckinlay, whose entire previous fortnight was four messages and fourteen words, wrote five messages this window including his first substantive multi-sentence reply since Aug 18 and a genuinely warm one on Sep 15. But the same invoice that restored the reminder introduced the FIFTH banking change in six months — 'Please note a slight name change to the account, but the same account and wire info. This should help alleviate any bounce backs or issues moving forward' (Sep 15) — and the phrase 'bounce backs' is the first time ALTR has admitted in this chat that payments have been failing, while TWO earlier transfers (Aug 17, now 32 days, and Sep 5, now 13 days) have still never been confirmed as received. Vale's Sep 16 payment got 'Thank you love!' — the third consecutive payment acknowledged rather than verified. Three payments into a changing account, with ALTR itself raising bounce-backs, is the single most concrete financial risk on this account. The week's other revelation came from the screenshot thread. Vale posted another unlabelled image captioned 'Again' on Sep 13 and another on Sep 14 with 'What is going on ?'. Mayson escalated inside four minutes ('@olkmck let’s get this in line') and Ollie finally answered on Sep 14 — 16 days after the Aug 29 escalation and 4 days after the Sep 10 one — with 'I am not sure what that is about to be honest'. The good news buried in that exchange is that these are NOT new chatter/PPV incidents: they are OnlyFans account alerts, so the fan-trust clean streak genuinely now stands at 38 days since Aug 11. The bad news is far bigger. Pressed on why she keeps screenshotting them, Vale disclosed on Sep 15: 'I lost access to my account for Nine days before because I had a chatter say that I was 16 in one of the videos so that was really stressful getting my account back so anytime I see any alerts I’m just scared of losing my account again especially now with more money on it but thank you.' A chatter's words have already cost this client nine days of her entire income, and ALTR's response was 'Yeah no worries at all, you won’t lose your account' — an unqualified guarantee no account manager can make, with no ticket raised, no audit of the alerts, and still no written account rulebook 37 days after the only remedy ever offered. Meanwhile the paid-but-undelivered backlog went a FIFTH consecutive window with zero mentions by anyone: John's $2,000 custom plus the $200 ASAP fee is 27 days delivered-and-unconfirmed, the March-to-date reconciliation is 31 days unstarted, Ryan's $600 videocall is 104 days from sale, John's $1,800 videocall 140 days, Tyler's $700 JOI custom 166 days. Mica Vecco broke 15 days of silence on Sep 15 with 'hi bb! how is everything going?' — not the comparative reel insights she herself asked for on Aug 31, not a verdict on the three-variant hook test the client ran for her, not a word about whether reach recovered. Vale answered 'Been struggling to get new followers' and Mica did not reply to it at all; her next message, two days later, was a mass-template Instagram security broadcast. The Instagram problem is 18 days old, the client says it is still bad, and the person who diagnosed it has never come back to it. And the direction of the asks reversed completely: Mayson chased Vale for the Snapchat upload three times in 48 hours (Sep 11, Sep 12, Sep 13) until she apologised — 'No my bad will do today' — while her own Sep 10 question about WHICH of her two Snapchat accounts he wants admin on is 8 days unanswered, and on Sep 16 he opened a third front by asking for a Facebook account. The client is now apologising to ALTR for being late while ALTR owes her twenty-plus items, two of them over 160 days old. The window closed with three photos from Vale on Sep 17 — most likely the Lost Lands festival content she promised on Sep 15 'so that the fans feel like they’re there with me' — sitting in the OnlyFans topic with no reply from anyone.
